title: Deconstructing Long Chain-of-Thought: A Structured Reasoning Optimization Framework for Long CoT Distillation
authors_zh: Yijia Luo、Yulin Song、Xingyao Zhang、Jiaheng Liu、Weixun Wang、GengRu Chen、Wenbo Su、Bo Zheng
paper_type_zh: 推理轨迹、搜索或测试时计算研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计 rollout、选择器、预算、数据谱系与复现边界的读者
one_line: DLCoT parses long mathematical teacher traces into structured approaches and verifications, prunes redundant branches for SFT, and releases processing code plus a Step 1 input rather than a confirmed final optimized corpus.
该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。
why: DLCoT makes trace structure, filtering, clustering, and deletion choices auditable construction variables, but its public repository is a recipe plus Step 1 input rather than a reusable release of the final optimized distillation data.
inclusion_reason: This rollout/search/trace-data entry turns long teacher reasoning into explicit structural units and tests which branches to retain for SFT, while exposing a release boundary between an input artifact, a multi-stage recipe, and an unconfirmed final optimized corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long-CoT distillation can transfer mathematical reasoning to smaller models, but the useful training object is not simply “a longer answer”: teacher traces mix repeated approaches, abandoned branches, verification, corrected mistakes, and final conclusions, and their transfer can depend on student-model homology. This 2025 arXiv paper asks which structural parts should be preserved or removed before SFT. For this atlas category, the decision boundary is explicit: DLCoT is an offline trace-construction and ablation study over QwQ-32B-Preview and DeepSeek-R1 outputs, not a test-time search method and not evidence that a complete optimized corpus has been released. The auditable objects are the original teacher trace, its parsed approach/verification units, cluster and label decisions, the reconstructed trace, and the terminal final-answer check.

长 CoT 蒸馏可以把数学推理行为迁移到较小模型，但有用的训练对象并不只是“更长的答案”：教师轨迹混合了重复方案、放弃的分支、验证、被后续纠正的错误和最终结论，而且迁移效果可能依赖学生模型与教师的同源性。这篇 2025 年 arXiv 论文研究在 SFT 前应保留或删除哪些结构。对本图谱类别而言，边界必须明确：DLCoT 是针对 QwQ-32B-Preview 与 DeepSeek-R1 输出的离线轨迹构建和消融研究，不是测试时搜索方法，也不能证明完整优化语料已经发布。可审计对象包括原始教师轨迹、解析出的方案/验证单元、聚类与标签决策、重构轨迹和最终答案检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DLCoT treats a long teacher response as a structured trace rather than an indivisible demonstration. It separates broad reasoning regions, further decomposes approach exploration and verification, labels candidate approaches as correct, incomplete, or erroneous while also flagging calculation/derivation errors, clusters similar approaches, removes redundant members while retaining at least one approach per cluster, and minimally reconstructs coherence before student SFT. The feedback contract is mixed: rule-based final-answer validation controls entry to the distillation pool, while LLM judgments and similarity checks control decomposition, labeling, clustering, and editing. The public artifact boundary matters: SODE supplies processing code and a Step 1 inference input, whereas users must run the intervening LLM calls themselves to obtain optimized training data; no completed final corpus or retained-row manifest was verified.

DLCoT 不把长教师回答视为不可分割的单条示范，而是把它作为结构化轨迹处理。流程先划分大的推理区域，再细分方案探索与验证，将候选方案标为正确、不完整或错误，并另行标注计算/推导错误；随后对相似方案聚类，在每个簇至少保留一个方案的前提下删除冗余成员，最后以尽量少的改写恢复连贯性，再用于学生 SFT。反馈契约是混合式的：规则化最终答案验证控制样本能否进入蒸馏池，LLM 判断和相似度检查则控制分解、标注、聚类与编辑。公开 artifact 的边界很重要：SODE 提供处理代码和 Step 1 推理输入，但使用者必须自行运行中间 LLM 调用才能得到优化训练数据；没有核验到已完成的最终语料或保留行清单。

title: Method
方法
html: The paper combines about 16K NuminaMath-derived prompts with about 17K Bespoke-Stratos items. It reports 33K QwQ-32B-Preview traces and 16K DeepSeek-R1 traces, generated with top-k 1, top-p 0.5, temperature 0.5, and 32,768 maximum new tokens; only responses passing rule-based final-answer validation are retained. DLCoT then performs macro parsing, free-form approach/verification segmentation, correctness and derivation-error labeling, similarity clustering, redundancy or optional incorrectness reduction, and minimal-edit coherence reconstruction. The repository README assigns Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct to steps 1, 2, 3, and 5 and GPT-4o to step 4, and repeatedly requires the user to run inference and append a result field. Its only data-directory object is the Git-LFS-backed 20250209_deepseek_r1_math_26K.jsonl, documented as Step 1 input; Step 5 files are prompts whose inference outputs would become optimized training data. Reported students use six SFT epochs, cosine annealing, learning rate 1e-5, and batch size 96.

论文组合约 16K 个 NuminaMath 衍生提示和约 17K 个 Bespoke-Stratos 条目，报告得到 33K 条 QwQ-32B-Preview 轨迹与 16K 条 DeepSeek-R1 轨迹；生成参数为 top-k 1、top-p 0.5、temperature 0.5、最大新 token 数 32,768，并且只保留通过规则化最终答案验证的回答。DLCoT 随后执行宏观解析、自由形式的方案/验证分段、正确性与推导错误标注、相似方案聚类、冗余删除或可选的错误删除，以及最小改写式连贯性重构。仓库 README 指定步骤 1、2、3、5 使用 Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct，步骤 4 使用 GPT-4o，并多次要求用户自行运行推理后补入 result 字段。data 目录唯一对象是由 Git LFS 承载的 20250209_deepseek_r1_math_26K.jsonl，README 将其定义为 Step 1 输入；Step 5 产生的仍是待推理文件，其推理输出才会成为优化训练数据。报告中的学生模型采用 6 个 SFT epoch、余弦退火、学习率 1e-5 和 batch size 96。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence is an ablation over the paper's own construction pipeline, not proof that the data or judges are intrinsically high quality. For QwQ data with Qwen2.5-14B, the reported baseline scores on AIME2024/MATH500/GSM8K are 33.3/85.3/96.2, while removing all redundant approaches yields 40.0/87.7/96.8; for R1 data with the same student, the corresponding comparison is 46.7/91.7/97.6 versus 53.3/91.4/96.8, so the effect is not uniformly positive across benchmarks. After maximal redundancy reduction, also deleting erroneous approaches lowers the QwQ-student scores from 40.0/87.7/96.8 to 33.3/84.5/96.3 and the R1-student scores from 53.3/91.4/96.8 to 40.0/88.2/93.8, supporting the narrower interpretation that later-corrected or diverse branches can be useful in the tested setup. The arXiv record, official BibTeX, SODE code, README, scripts, and Step 1 LFS input are accessible; a final optimized corpus is not.

这里的证据是对论文本身构建流程的消融，而不是数据或判断器具有内在高质量的证明。对使用 QwQ 数据的 Qwen2.5-14B，论文报告的 AIME2024/MATH500/GSM8K 基线分数为 33.3/85.3/96.2，删除全部冗余方案后为 40.0/87.7/96.8；对使用 R1 数据的同一学生，对应比较为 46.7/91.7/97.6 与 53.3/91.4/96.8，因此效果并未在所有基准上一致提高。在最大限度删除冗余后继续删除错误方案，会把 QwQ 学生的分数从 40.0/87.7/96.8 降至 33.3/84.5/96.3，也会把 R1 学生从 53.3/91.4/96.8 降至 40.0/88.2/93.8；这支持一个更窄的解释：在该实验设置中，后来被纠正的分支或多样方案可能有用。arXiv 记录、官方 BibTeX、SODE 代码、README、脚本和 Step 1 LFS 输入可以访问，但尚未核验到最终优化语料发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Direct long-CoT distillation normally treats each correct teacher response as one SFT target, and generic long-to-short work often optimizes length without exposing which internal branches were removed. DLCoT's distinctive contribution is to make approaches, verifications, clusters, redundancy, and corrected-error branches explicit construction variables, then compare deletion policies across teacher/student families. Its result argues against equating the shortest clean-looking trace with the best supervision: deleting repeated members can help, while deleting nonredundant erroneous paths can damage self-correction structure. Final-answer filtering, teacher distillation, clustering, and SFT are not individually new, and the paper does not establish a general verifier or universal compression policy beyond the tested mathematical models and datasets.

直接长 CoT 蒸馏通常把每条答案正确的教师回答当成一个完整 SFT 目标，通用 long-to-short 工作也常只优化长度，而不暴露内部哪些分支被删除。DLCoT 的区别在于把方案、验证、聚类、冗余和被后续纠正的错误分支变成显式构建变量，再跨教师/学生模型族比较删除策略。结果反对把“最短且看起来最干净”的轨迹直接等同于最佳监督：删除重复成员可能有利，而删除非冗余错误路径可能破坏自我纠正结构。最终答案过滤、教师蒸馏、聚类和 SFT 本身都不是新方法；论文也没有在所测数学模型与数据之外证明一种通用验证器或普适压缩策略。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Rule-based final-answer checks do not validate intermediate mathematics, while LLM parsing, classification, and clustering introduce judge error that lexical source-preservation thresholds cannot detect. The paper reports three-run experiments but does not expose row-level variance, retained indices, rejected traces, or a complete final-corpus manifest. The repository is not an end-to-end frozen pipeline: users must supply several LLM inference stages, model revisions and service behavior are not fully pinned, and defaults visible in individual scripts do not make the executed configuration unambiguous. The Step 1 object is an LFS input file, not the final optimized dataset; code/data licenses, source-to-output lineage, splits, and decontamination remain unknown. The study also leaves substantially different model designs and downstream reinforcement-learning use untested.

规则化最终答案检查不能验证中间数学过程，而 LLM 分解、分类和聚类会引入判断误差，词面源文本保真阈值也无法检测数学语义错误。论文报告实验重复三次，但未公开逐行方差、保留索引、拒绝轨迹或完整最终语料清单。仓库不是冻结的端到端流水线：用户必须自行提供若干 LLM 推理阶段，模型版本和服务行为没有完全固定，单个脚本中可见的默认值也不足以唯一确定实际执行配置。Step 1 对象是 LFS 输入文件，而不是最终优化数据集；代码/数据许可、源到输出谱系、划分和去污染情况仍为 unknown。研究还未充分测试设计范式明显不同的模型，也没有测试下游强化学习用途。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout_search_test_time_trace_data category, this paper is useful as a schema for auditing offline traces produced by long-running reasoning policies: preserve the original rollout, terminal answer check, every parsed branch, cluster assignment, label, deletion decision, reconstruction prompt/output, and the student checkpoint that consumed it. A builder can compare “remove duplicate branches” against “remove all incorrect-looking branches” without confusing token reduction with trace quality, and can use the released code as a partial recipe after independently pinning inference models and validating mathematics. It should not be cited as a ready-to-download optimized corpus. A reusable release would need immutable final rows, rejected/intermediate outputs, exact source mappings, verifier error analysis, licenses, splits, and benchmark-overlap checks.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 类别而言，本文可作为审计长时间推理策略所生成离线轨迹的 schema：应保留原始 rollout、最终答案检查、每个解析分支、聚类归属、标签、删除决策、重构提示/输出，以及实际消费该数据的学生检查点。构建者可以比较“删除重复分支”和“删除所有看似错误的分支”，而不把 token 减少误认为轨迹质量提升；在自行固定推理模型并验证数学正确性后，也可把公开代码作为部分配方使用。它不能被引用为可直接下载的完整优化语料。可复用发布还需要不可变的最终记录、被拒绝和中间输出、精确源映射、验证器误差分析、许可、划分和基准重叠检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the paper's 33K QwQ and 16K R1 experimental traces from the repository's differently scoped 20250209_deepseek_r1_math_26K.jsonl processing input.
  • The entry filter is rule-based final-answer correctness; later segmentation, labels, clusters, and reconstruction rely on LLM judgments and similarity checks.
  • Maximal redundancy removal is not the same as deleting every erroneous branch: the latter hurts several reported scores and can remove later-corrected reasoning.
  • SODE documents a multi-stage recipe, but external inference is required and no completed optimized corpus, retained-row manifest, license, split, or decontamination report was verified.

• 区分论文实验中的 33K 条 QwQ 与 16K 条 R1 轨迹，以及仓库中范围不同的 20250209_deepseek_r1_math_26K.jsonl 处理输入。
  • 入口过滤依据规则化最终答案正确性；后续分段、标签、聚类与重构依赖 LLM 判断和相似度检查。
  • 最大限度删除冗余不等于删除每个错误分支；后者会降低若干报告分数，也可能删掉后来被纠正的推理。
  • SODE 记录了多阶段配方，但需要外部推理；没有核验到完成的优化语料、保留行清单、许可、划分或去污染报告。
